text:
Asha (CSM): Heads-up: PulseWave finished onboarding and submitted a short feedback list. They explicitly said billing visibility is hurting renewals. Need quick triage so we can show progress at the renewal check-in on 2026-04-06. Main asks: 1) route-level billing toggle (hide token-costs by default), 2) exportable flagged-feedback CSV per-project, 3) embedding cache controls (TTL + manual invalidate), plus a complaint about noisy retries when model variants fall back.

Priya (PM): thanks. Can you paste the exact lines they sent? we need concrete examples to build acceptance criteria. Also: rank by business impact (high/med/low) and how often they hit each issue.

Asha (CSM): pasted from their DM (redacted):
> "Our finance reviewers get overwhelmed by token columns. We want an admin toggle per route to hide token-level details unless asked."
> "We need a one-click CSV dump of all flagged transcripts for our PMs to import into JIRA."
> "When we retrain embeddings we need to kick the cache for the project. Today it's unclear how to do that."
> "Fallbacks cause us surprise spend during off-hours; it looks like retries spike when a variant hits an error."

Gabe (CS-OPS): added telemetry: PulseWave ~95k tokens/day. Last 7d fallback rate ~14% with a small spike between 02:30-04:00 UTC. That correlates with a nightly batch they run. If retries multiply concurrency we can see 2x cost during the window.

Jared (Eng): per-route toggle: if routes have metadata we can add a boolean on the Route object and honor it in billing UI/export. Backend + UI + export filter. Estimate: 3 dev days + QA. Low risk.

Priya (PM): CSV export schema ask: Asha, ask PulseWave for fields. From support sample I'd expect: project, route, flagged_at, user_id, flag_type, snippet, model_variant, notes. Asha pls confirm.

Lena (Support): they sent this sample header in support ticket:
```
project,route,usr_id,flagged_at,reason,snippet,model
pulsewave,route-A,usr_987,2026-03-16T02:11:00Z,privacy,"asked to redact email",gptx-3-small
```

Asha (CSM): added sample to ticket. Also noted: they asked for a manual "Invalidate embeddings" button scoped to project and an optional TTL (hours or days).

Priya (PM): proposed prioritization: (H) billing toggle — direct renewal signal, (M) CSV export — enables their workflow, (M) retry mitigations — ops to prevent cost spikes, (L) cache controls — important for retrain but larger UX surface. Opinions?

Gabe (CS-OPS): I suggest making retry mitigation higher priority if the nightly batch keeps triggering 10%+ fallback. Can we add a short-term guard: limit retries per request and add exponential backoff? That will cap cost while we plan a circuit-breaker.

Jared (Eng): agree. Quick mitigation plan: cap retries to 2, exponential backoff, and emit metric fallback_limited=true for events. Short-term: ~2 dev days. Medium-term: per-variant circuit breaker + auto-eviction from routing when error-rate high.

Asha (CSM): Action items I captured:
- Asha: confirm CSV fields + sample imports PulseWave needs (EOD).
- Priya: draft PRD stub for billing toggle + CSV + cache controls and effort estimates (end of week).
- Jared: implement retry cap POC + metric (deliver by next Tue).
- Gabe: add alert rule: fallback_rate > 10% over 6h for PulseWave tag; add to ops board.
- Lena: prep demo CSV and ingestion notes for the sync.

comms-bot: Created ticket CS-3499 "PulseWave: billing visibility + feedback export + cache/ops mitigations" (<https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-3499>).

Priya (PM): I'll set a 30min sync with PulseWave next Wed and invite eng + ops. Asha please invite relevant PD and finance contacts.

Asha (CSM): will do. They mentioned renewal anxiety: "If we can't show clearer billing next month we're likely to downgrade." We should add a short slide to the renewal deck highlighting this work.

Lena (Support): noted, I'll prepare a short demo comparing current CSV vs proposed fields.

Jared (Eng): snippet for ticket (short-term retry cap):
```
// retry cap pseudo
if (req.retryCount >= 2) {
  emitMetric('fallback_limited', true);
  return error('fallback_limit_reached');
}
await retryWithBackoff();
```

Gabe (CS-OPS): tagging @priya and @jared  I will instrument fallback_rate and set the alert threshold. Adding to sprint board now.

Asha (CSM): thanks team  goal is PRD + triage done before renewal check-in on 2026-04-06. :thumbsup:

Priya (PM): will post updates in the ticket and follow up here.

Lena (Support): +1, demo ready for sync.

(comms-bot): Ticket CS-3499 moved to "In Progress" by Priya."
